config.construction_method: release_time = earliest recorded timestamp among the round's workload shots; planned_time = recorded timestamp at which the pair's recorded outcomes were complete (later shot); deterministic, no random seed
config.device_note: slot grid identical to the previous evaluation (capacity unchanged)
config.outcomes: recorded outcomes carried as metadata for replay; nothing is newly measured
config.partition: holdout (last 25% of the timeline, the partition the three-policy evaluation scores)
config.randomness: none: the workload is a deterministic function of the recorded trace and the registry
config.request_pairing: existing production round-robin matching over the Comparable pairs (unchanged)
config.shots_per_request: 1 shot of each of the two circuits (2 per request), as in the previous evaluation

field_semantics.execution_time: produced only by the scheduler simulation (C); never stored here
field_semantics.historical_time_*, source_index_*: provenance only; never seen by the scheduler
field_semantics.outcome_*: recorded outcomes carried for replay; nothing is newly measured
field_semantics.planned_time: reference instant the comparison describes (B); immutable; not a deadline, not re-measured
field_semantics.release_time: when the request becomes available to the scheduler (A); immutable
